latest_release.name: v0.4.1
latest_release.body:
OpenFilm 0.4.1 makes timeline previews more responsive, adds export for a marked range, and makes it easier to continue work after an interruption.

## Highlights

- **Faster timeline previews.** Scrub through available frames and release to give the chosen position priority. Studio can show a cached frame while a chapter opens, preloads upcoming pages during playback, and keeps the previous picture visible while the preview catches up. The loading message over the picture is gone.
- **Export a timeline range.** Set the in and out points with `I` and `O` or the Time Range menu. Open Export with `⌘M` on macOS or `Ctrl+M` on Windows to export the marked range.
- **Continue an interrupted task.** Stop a task and resume it in the same conversation using the model and reasoning effort selected in the composer. If you switch agents, the new agent gets the original request and saved progress.
- **Smoother editing.** Drag a clip over the middle of another to preview a replacement or near an edge to insert it. Linked clips follow the main track as it moves, and selecting a marker previews its frame before playback starts there.

Thanks to everyone who sent reports and pull requests. Thanks especially to @hobostay for the fix that prevents Studio from getting stuck while trimming edit history. [#505](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/pull/505)

## Install or update

Run `npx -y openfilm@latest` for the CLI, or download the desktop installer from Assets below. Existing desktop installations can update from the app.

## Desktop app

- OpenFilm and own-key agents can retry interrupted model requests from the last completed tool result. When a request still fails, connection details show the failed stage, elapsed time, retry count, and available error code or request ID.
- The chat stays in place as working status, commands, and replies arrive. Click the conversation title for history or to start a new chat. The attachment menu has more space above the composer.
- Studio can reconnect after a failed restart and copy local diagnostics while disconnected.
- On Windows, closing during an agent task, export, or media generation minimizes the window so the work can finish. Updates and uninstalls protect projects and personal media stored in the install directory.
- Storage settings move your personal asset library with the projects folder, including across drives. Studio can recover the project list when its local index is damaged.

## Everything in OpenFilm 0.4.1

### Preview and timeline

- Preview files load on a dedicated server thread, allowing footage, images, and pages to load while Studio reads a project or prepares other work.
- Long timelines open with less work on each playhead update. Studio prepares lightweight playback copies in the background for footage that is slow to seek and can play supported copies of formats such as HEVC Main 10 and ProRes when a device cannot decode the original.
- A new pointer position supersedes older seek requests. Studio can start Play from a decoded cached frame after a jump and recover if the live frame cannot finish drawing promptly.
- The viewer restores its picture when switching between workspaces and retries if a film changes while its first frame is loading.
- Insert previews follow the pointer for audio as well as video. Locked-track clips stay out of selection. Collapse track controls from the divider and reopen them from the track menu.
- Thumbnails retain their aspect ratio at different zoom levels. Timeline zoom shortcuts work from the viewer, and the divider sits to the left of the cover control.

### Export

- Exports use the timeline as it was when you added the job. The dialog opens without scanning the project folder, and the queue reports stages such as mixing, loudness adjustment, muxing, and saving.
- Video exports can mix sound while drawing frames, load pages as needed, and fall back sooner if hardware encoding stalls. On Apple silicon, Auto can use more drawing workers when

detail.readme:
The open source AI video agent.

English | 简体中文 | 繁體中文 | 한국어 | Deutsch | Español | Français | Italiano | Dansk | 日本語 | Polski | Русский | Bosanski | العربية | Norsk | Português (Brasil) | ไทย | Türkçe | Українська | বাংলা | Ελληνικά | Tiếng Việt

[![OpenFilm: an agent makes a film while you watch, then you change it by hand](docs/openfilm.webp)](https://openfilm.dev) --- ### About OpenFilm turns any coding agent into a video agent, with editors to change anything it makes. You and the agent work on the same film, together and live. Whatever the agent changes, you see as it happens; whatever you change, the agent sees too. The agent does most of the work; you point at anything and ask for a change, or make it yourself. - **The agent makes the film.** Use Claude Code, Codex, any other coding agent, or the one built into the desktop app. It finds footage, music and voices, writes each shot and cuts them together while you watch. - **Point at anything.** A clip, a moment, a stretch of the timeline, a spot in the frame, a line of subtitles, a card on the canvas. Point at it, say what you want, and the agent knows exactly what you mean. - **Change it by hand.** Inside any shot, move, scale and rotate any element, retype its text, restyle its color, font and size, and animate it, even word by word. On the timeline, trim, split and reorder clips, change their speed, volume and fades, crop, grade and cut out the background, and edit subtitles and voice-over. Your edits land in the same files, and the agent builds on them. ### Installation **Desktop app.** [Download it for macOS or Windows](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/releases/latest). Everything you need comes with it, down to a built-in agent, and it works with Claude Code or Codex if you already use them. **Your own coding agent.** Add the skill (needs Node 22.2+ and ffmpeg), then ask for a film: ```bash npx skills add openfilm/openfilm ``` > Make a 20-second launch video for my CLI, with music. ### Editors Each editor is a different way to work on the same film, and in every one you and the agent work together. OpenFilm comes with four, and more official editors are in development for different kinds of people: simple enough for anyone to pick up, and professional workbenches for those who want them. Editors follow the Community's open standard, so anyone can build one and share it. - **Screening**: watch the film full size. Click a moment, drag across a stretch or circle part of the frame, and the agent knows what you are pointing at. - **Edit**: a full timeline of clips, text, captions, voice-over and sound. Move, scale and restyle anything inside a shot. Export a video, or take the timeline to Final Cut Pro, Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve. - **Canvas**: a board for planning, with notes, images, clips and voices side by side. Generate each with your services, then send them to the timeline in order. - **Color**: grade every clip with scopes, color wheels and curves, from camera log footage or with `.cube` LUTs. What you preview is what you export. All four share one library: your own footage in folders, linked rather than copied and found again when you move it, alongside OpenFilm's free music, sound effects, voices and stickers. ### Community The Community is an open standard for everything you can add to OpenFilm, and anyone can build for it. - **Plugins** extend OpenFilm itself with new editors and connectors to outside services. OpenFilm's own editors are plugins, built the same way as anyone's. - **Skills** teach the agent a way of making a kind of film. - **Assets** are music, sound effects, transitions, effects, text styles, stickers and templates. - **Examples** are complete projects to learn from and remix. Each is a plain folder. Add one from the Community window in OpenFilm, or build your own: [make a plugin](packages/openfilm/plugins/README.md), [write a skill](https://github.com/openfilm/community/blob/main/SPEC.md), [share assets](https://github.com/openfilm/community/blob/main/assets/CONTRIBUTING.md), or share a finished film as an example, then list it in [openfilm/community](https://github.com/openfilm/community). ### How it works A film is a folder with a `film.html`: tracks of clips, styled with CSS. ```html
``` Each shot is a web page whose one function, `frame(t)`, draws any moment with anything a browser can draw (three.js, WebGL, canvas, SVG, CSS, GSAP, video) and always the same picture for the same `t`, so it renders the same on any machine, the agent can check every frame, and no framework such as Remotion or HyperFrames is needed. ```js window.film = { frame(t) { /* draw the complete picture at t seconds */ }, }; ``` **Your changes stay yours.** When you change something inside a shot by hand, such as its text, color, position or size, OpenFilm saves it in the clip's `overrides` rather than in the page's code. The agent can rewrite the page and your changes still apply. The full format is in [SPEC.md](packages/openfilm/SPEC.md). ### Contributing To run OpenFilm from source or send a pull request, read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Report bugs in [Issues](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/issues) with the report from Settings → Developer → Copy report, and security issues as [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) describes. ### Star History
detail.readme_zh:
开源的 AI 视频智能体。

English | 简体中文 | 繁體中文 | 한국어 | Deutsch | Español | Français | Italiano | Dansk | 日本語 | Polski | Русский | Bosanski | العربية | Norsk | Português (Brasil) | ไทย | Türkçe | Українська | বাংলা | Ελληνικά | Tiếng Việt

[![OpenFilm：智能体做片子，你在旁边看着，再亲手修改](docs/openfilm.webp)](https://openfilm.dev) --- ### 简介 OpenFilm 让任何编程智能体都能做视频，再配上编辑器，它做出的一切你都能改。 你和智能体实时协作，做的是同一部片子：智能体改了什么，你马上就能看到；你改了什么，智能体也能看到。大部分由智能体完成；你可以指着任何东西让它改，也可以自己动手。 - **智能体来做。** 用 Claude Code、Codex、其他编程智能体，或桌面版自带的智能体。它找素材、音乐和配音，写好每个镜头再剪到一起，你在旁边看着片子成形。 - **指着说。** 一个片段、某一刻、时间线上的一段、画面里的一块、一句字幕、画布上的一张卡片。指给它，说你想怎么改，智能体就知道你说的是哪里。 - **亲手改。** 镜头里的任何元素都能移动、缩放、旋转，改文字，改颜色、字体、字号等样式，加动画，连逐字逐词的文字动画也行；时间线上能剪短、分割、调换顺序，改速度、音量和淡入淡出，裁剪画面、调色、抠像，改字幕和配音。你的改动写进同一份文件，智能体会在此基础上接着做。 ### 安装 **桌面版。** [下载 macOS 或 Windows 版](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/releases/latest)。需要的一切都已经装好，包括内置智能体；你在用 Claude Code 或 Codex 的话，也能直接接上。 **你自己的编程智能体。** 安装技能（需要 Node 22.2+ 和 ffmpeg），然后让它做一部片子： ```bash npx skills add openfilm/openfilm ``` > 给我的命令行工具做一个 20 秒的发布视频，配上音乐。 ### 编辑器 每个编辑器都是处理同一部片子的一种方式，在每一个里都是你和智能体协同工作。OpenFilm 现在自带四个，更多官方编辑器正在开发中，面向不同的人：普通人一上手就会用，专业的人也有自己的专业工作台。编辑器遵循社区的开放标准，任何人都可以开发自己的编辑器并分享出来。 - **放映**：大屏看片。点一个时刻、拖过一段，或在画面上圈出一块，智能体就知道你指的是什么。 - **剪辑**：完整的时间线，放片段、文字、字幕、配音和声音。镜头里的任何东西都能移动、缩放、改样式。导出视频，或把时间线带到 Final Cut Pro、Premiere Pro、DaVinci Resolve。 - **画布**：构思用的白板，笔记、图片、片段、声音并排摆开。用你的服务逐个生成，再按顺序送上时间线。 - **调色**：用示波器、色轮和曲线给每个片段调色，支持相机 Log 素材和 `.cube` LUT。预览什么样，导出就什么样。 四个编辑器共用一个素材库：你自己的素材按文件夹管理，链接而不复制，挪了位置也能找回；旁边是 OpenFilm 免费的音乐、音效、声音和贴纸。 ### 社区 社区是一套开放标准，涵盖所有能加进 OpenFilm 的东西，任何人都能为它开发。 - **插件**给 OpenFilm 本身加上新的编辑器，以及连接外部服务的连接器。OpenFilm 自带的编辑器也是插件，和任何人的做法一样。 - **技能**教智能体做某一类片子的方法。 - **素材**包括音乐、音效、转场、特效、文字样式、贴纸和模板。 - **示例**是完整的项目，可以照着学，也可以拿来改。 每一样都是一个普通文件夹。在 OpenFilm 的社区窗口里添加，或者自己做：[做插件](packages/openfilm/plugins/README.md)、[写技能](https://github.com/openfilm/community/blob/main/SPEC.md)、[分享素材](https://github.com/openfilm/community/blob/main/assets/CONTRIBUTING.md)，或把成片作为示例分享，然后提交到 [openfilm/community](https://github.com/openfilm/community)。 ### 原理 一部片子是一个带 `film.html` 的文件夹：一条条轨道上的片段，用 CSS 设置样式。 ```html
``` 每个镜头是一个网页，只靠一个函数 `frame(t)` 画出任意一刻，浏览器能画的都能用（three.js、WebGL、canvas、SVG、CSS、GSAP、视频），同一个 `t` 永远画出同一个画面，所以在任何机器上渲染都一样，智能体也能逐帧检查，不需要 Remotion、HyperFrames 这类框架。 ```js window.film = { frame(t) { /* 画出第 t 秒的完整画面 */ }, }; ``` **你的改动不会丢。** 你在镜头里亲手改的文字、颜色、位置、大小，OpenFilm 存在片段的 `overrides` 里，不动页面代码。智能体重写页面以后，你的改动照样生效。完整格式见 [SPEC.md](packages/openfilm/SPEC.md)。 ### 参与贡献 想从源码运行 OpenFilm 或提交 PR，请先读 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。Bug 提到 [Issues](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/issues)，附上 设置 → 开发者 → 复制报告 里的报告；安全问题按 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) 的说明报告。 ### Star History
